do_not_edit_constraint.detail: Zero of the 55 comment sites AND zero of the 72 duplicate declarations live in these three files. No conflict on the deletion side.
do_not_edit_constraint.important_interaction: Branch.lean OWNS the definitions (Accessibility, hasEdge, modalKnownWorlds, boxPositivesOf) and already hosts 4 public lemmas about them. The architecturally natural home for the 33 Tier-1 facts IS Branch.lean. The do-not-edit constraint is exactly WHY a separate Support/ directory is correct rather than arbitrary. State this in the new modules' docstrings so a future reader does not fold them back into Branch.lean.
